author: blu
body: A standalone Option A payload that renders the 3D scene on whatever framebuffer the firmware actually reported, and then sits so it can be photographed. It exists to separate the renderer from the first-boot ceremony: the desktop is reached through a wizard, and a wizard that stops taking keys hides whether the pipeline works at all.

author: blu
body: It fills the whole panel with a band colour first and renders into a rectangle inset by the sidebar width, so the untouched band down the left is itself the containment proof, visible on the glass.
